subtitle: Cards & Stats
- Control Cards
- Phone Stats
- CPU & Sensors (needs Shizuku)
- Battery Health (needs Shizuku)
---
**A home you put together from the controls you use**, and the phone's own load in the shell's Phone tab, with much more of it when Shizuku runs.

### Home
- **Seven new cards**, added from *Settings → Edit home screen → Add cards* (none are added for you, so your home stays as it was):
  - **Workspaces:** the current one big, 1–10 with a dot per open window.
  - **Modes & routines:** the shell's modes as toggles and your routines, one tap to run.
  - **Presets:** apply a saved look to the shell.
  - **Touchpad:** a small touchpad with both mouse buttons, right on the home.
  - **Presenter:** next, previous, start, black screen and end.
  - **Deck:** your deck's first eight keys, live.
  - **Power:** restart or shut down the PC, asking first.
- The touchpad and the clicker wake the PC's side only on the first touch and let it go when you leave the home.

### Phone stats on the PC
- **A Stats tab** in the shell's Phone tab (the bottom group, next to Mirror, Webcam and Mic): memory with the last minute, free storage, the thermal state, the battery's heat and power, network speed and each core's clock.
- **The phone samples only while that panel is on screen**, every 2 s, and nothing otherwise. The tab shows only with this version of the app.

### Detailed stats with Shizuku
Android closes overall CPU use and sensor temperatures to apps. **With [Shizuku](https://shizuku.rikka.app/) running and ii tools allowed in it**, the Stats panel adds:
- CPU use per core and the GPU's;
- sensor temperatures: skin, CPU, GPU, RAM, modem, USB;
- the busiest apps right now;
- battery health and storage by type.

Turn it on in *Settings → Detailed stats with Shizuku* (also in *Phone data*): the row walks you through installing, starting and allowing Shizuku. It runs a small shell-level process only while the PC watches. **Without Shizuku, everything else works as before.**

**Needs the latest [ii-p3drovfx](https://github.com/P3DROVFX/ii-p3drovfx) shell (`dev` branch)** for the Stats tab. Older shells simply don't show it.
